cross_product_finding: Creating a role in SGW is structurally closer to defining a small, ad hoc, admin-authored access-control POLICY OBJECT (a name plus a channel list, scoped to a specific scope/collection) than to assigning someone a role from a fixed catalog. There is no enumerable, product-shipped list of role names to choose from (unlike Capella's Organization Owner / Project Admin / etc., or even server/'s fixed privilege names) - 'Edge1' and 'Edge2' in these examples are entirely customer-invented strings, created and destroyed at will via a REST call. The one place this page's shape DOES echo the other batches is the cascading-revocation behavior: deleting a role in SGW silently revokes the channel access it conferred on every member, in the same spirit as revoking a Capella management-plane role removing its granted permissions - but the object being revoked (a channel-membership grant) is still a fundamentally different kind of thing than a privilege or an API-scoped role.
